agents.name: Coordinator
agents.job: Plans the investigation one evidence step at a time

agents.name: Observer
agents.job: Lists every visible part, marking and colour band

agents.name: Researcher
agents.job: Looks part markings up in real sources; no source, no fact

agents.name: Reporter
agents.job: Writes the report; every sentence cites evidence

agents.name: Explainer
agents.job: Optional: stronger follow-up answers (20 free requests a day)

agents.name: Video meter
agents.job: Times the blinking frame by frame

agents.name: Pattern matcher & checker
agents.job: Scores known circuits and tests the formula against the video

agents.name: Skeptic
agents.job: Flags any sentence that cites nothing or invents a number

agents.name: Backup models
agents.job: Answer when Gemini's free quota runs out (Groq key or local Ollama)

servers.name: duckduckgo
servers.purpose: web search and page reading, no key
servers.role_text: Part 1.2: looks up part markings and datasheets, with sources
servers.note: built-in rate limits: 30 searches and 20 fetches a minute

servers.name: tavily
servers.role_text: Part 1.2: looks up part markings and datasheets, with sources
servers.free: 1,000 credits a month, no card (basic search = 1 credit)

servers.name: fetch
servers.purpose: read any web page as text (datasheet pages)
servers.role_text: Part 1.2: looks up part markings and datasheets, with sources

servers.note: 22 tools upstream, half of them aliases

servers.name: spicelib
servers.purpose: SPICE simulation, for comparing simulations with measurements
servers.role_text: Part 2: runs SPICE on reconstructed circuits
servers.note: needs ngspice installed; pinned to mcp<2 because it breaks on the MCP SDK 2.x rename

servers.name: spicebridge
servers.purpose: SPICE with Monte Carlo, worst case and KiCad export
servers.role_text: Part 2: runs SPICE on reconstructed circuits
servers.reason: off by default (overlaps spicelib; 28 tools upstream)

servers.name: pcbparts
servers.purpose: JLCPCB parts search and live stock (Mouser, DigiKey optional)

servers.name: playwright
servers.purpose: drive a browser, e.g. a local shop's website
servers.reason: off by default (25 tools; it can click and submit forms, so it is off unless you turn it on)
servers.note: 25 tools; it can click and submit forms, so it is off unless you turn it on

servers.name: kicad_schematic
servers.purpose: read KiCad schematics, ERC, netlist and BOM export
servers.role_text: Part 2/3: reads and exports KiCad schematics
servers.note: 42 tools upstream; only read and export tools are kept, no editing

servers.name: genesis_recon
servers.purpose: the RECON node from Phase 1 (whitelisted pins, leases)
